description.value: Your name alone has cleared rooms in Cyber City and cleared camps in Dixie. Once per day, you can attempt to Demoralize every enemy within 60 feet simultaneously as a single action, at a -5 circumstance penalty to the check.

cinderfall.incomplete: This changes Demoralize's targeting profile (single target -> everyone within 60 feet) rather than adjusting a check total, the same problem as Break the Room -- no rule element retargets an existing action's scope.
